item.title: ‘Unbelievable’: Scott Jennings Doesn’t Let CNN Panelists Off The Hook As They Bring Up Trump’s Age
item.description: CNN senior political commentator Scott Jennings scoffed at his fellow "State of the Union" panelists Sunday as they suggested President Donald Trump is cognitively declining.

item.title: Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche Says Every Mention Of Trump In Epstein Files Will Be Released
item.description: Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche promised Sunday that every mention of President Donald Trump in the files surrounding deceased sex offender Jeffrey Epstein will be released to the public.

item.title: STEVE MILLOY: Trump Dismantles Climate-Industrial Complex
item.description: The Trump administration took a major whack at the climate-industrial complex this week. It’s a fantastic move. But another event this week spotlights the need to do more.

item.title: ‘The Wire’ Actor James Ransone Dead at 46 in Apparent Suicide
item.description: Ransone was married and the father of two children.

item.title: LARRY ELDER: What Rob Reiner Said About And Did To Donald Trump
item.description: Yes, President Donald Trump could have taken the high ground rather than excoriating Rob Reiner, the actor, director and producer found stabbed to death, along with his wife. The Reiners' son, Nick, has been arrested in connection with the murders.

item.title: Feds Say Minnesota Aid Fraud Balloons to $9B in ‘Industrial-Scale’ Scheme
item.description: The bulk of the scams were tied to false claims submitted by individuals who established nonprofits and aid businesses, many of them within the state’s Somali community.

item.title: Danika Troy’s Accused Killers, Ages 14 and 16, Will Stand Trial as Adults
item.description: What began as an online feud, authorities believe, led to a deadly ambush: the victim was allegedly shot multiple times before her body was set on fire.
